name: project-overview-owner-parity
goal: Prove owner-only fleet status and fresh Project Overview data, item, decision, and run detail from the shared Mac and iOS fixture.

evidence: Tracker wttfb9 and the existing owner overview contract define machine freshness, scoped quota, projected detail and Hub access fences. Reuse publisher telemetry and shared native owner fixture.
Shared owner projection exposes current run details and bounded queue and provider telemetry. Hub drops expired and revoked publishers without widening access.

Before: overview projection assertions lacked queue and run metadata, Hub API omitted expiry/revocation states, and the paired renderer could not find Review decision. After: 131 focused units, 30 Hub browser cases, 17 shared renderer cases, 5 built Mac cases, and all 8 native iOS Overview assertions passed with one synthetic owner fixture. Inspected Mac, native iOS, and Hub captures.
